about: Thresholds and word lists for the message checks. scripts/message_checks.py reads this file; campaign-qa, scenario-qa and engagement-send-preflight ship the same script and the same copy of this file, so change a rule in all three copies together (a test checks they match). Each key is explained under notes.

notes.subject_max_chars: A subject longer than this is a nitpick: desktop inboxes cut it off around here.
notes.preheader_max_chars: A preheader longer than this is a nitpick: inboxes show only the start.
notes.email_size_warning_kb: Rendered HTML at or above this many KB is a warning: Gmail clips it, which can hide the unsubscribe link.
notes.email_size_nitpick_kb: Rendered HTML at or above this many KB (but under the warning size) is a nitpick.
notes.min_text_chars: An email with images and fewer visible text characters than this is a warning (image-only emails hurt deliverability).
notes.max_unique_links: More unique links than this in one email is a nitpick.
notes.max_links_to_load: At most this many unique URLs go in links_to_load (primary first); the rest are listed in links_over_cap and reported as not checked.
notes.push_title_max_chars: A push title longer than this is a nitpick: it's likely to be truncated.
notes.push_body_max_chars: A push body longer than this is a nitpick: it's likely to be truncated.
notes.jinja_estimate_chars: Characters assumed for each {{ ... }} expression when estimating subject or SMS length before rendering.
notes.sms_brand_window_chars: The brand or sender name must appear within this many characters of the start of an SMS.
notes.spam_caps_word_min_len: All-capital words at least this long count towards the spam score (shorter ones are usually acronyms).
notes.spam_high_score: A spam score at or above this is high risk (a warning on an email about to launch).
notes.spam_medium_score: A spam score at or above this (but under spam_high_score) is medium risk.
notes.near_miss_max_edits: A link host this many character edits (or fewer) from another host in the same message, or differing only in top-level domain, is a near miss.
notes.placeholder_hosts: Link hosts that are never a real destination.
notes.placeholder_words: Words in a link's path or query that suggest a placeholder URL (a warning: confirm the real URL).
notes.placeholder_tokens: Regular expressions (case-insensitive unless wrapped in (?-i:...)) for merge tags from other tools or unfinished copy, such as [First Name], *|FNAME|*, Klaviyo person.first_name or [URL]. A match is a blocker.
notes.public_shorteners: Public link shorteners that carriers filter in SMS (a warning). A brand-owned shortener is fine.
notes.spam_phrases: Trigger phrases that add to the spam score when found as whole words in the subject or body.
notes.restricted_terms: SMS terms grouped by restricted category. A match is a warning for a person to judge; it never decides carrier approval.
